title: Keep pre-write remote verification read failures pending instead of final refusal
outcome: Only a refusal from the remote_verification_record write itself can terminate an admission; work-session reads and capability/revalidation failures retain unsent pending recovery.
acceptance: Behavioral evidence distinguishes an invalid_request from work_session_read (pending, no record write) from invalid_request or control_operation_idempotency_conflict returned by the actual record write (final refusal).
